soil.nitrogen_low: Nitrogen is low — apply urea or ammonium sulfate.
soil.nitrogen_high: Nitrogen is high — reduce nitrogen fertilizer.
soil.phosphorus_low: Phosphorus is low — apply SSP or DAP.
soil.potassium_low: Potassium is low — apply muriate of potash (MOP).
soil.ph_acidic: Soil is acidic — apply agricultural lime.
soil.ph_alkaline: Soil is alkaline — apply gypsum or organic matter.
soil.balanced: N-P-K and pH levels look balanced for most crops.
